instruction: The smooth scrolling feature in Chrome makes me dizzy. Can you disable the smooth scrolling experiment for me?

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the smooth scrolling experiment (smooth-scrolling) in Chrome flags. Uses existing evaluator infrastructure. Same difficulty as original - single experiment flag modification.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic error: Expected value logic is inverted - instruction says 'DISABLE' the experiment but evaluator checks if 'smooth-scrolling' IS in the enabled list
When disabling an experiment, it should be REMOVED from enabled_labs_experiments list (expected should be empty list [] or explicitly exclude 'smooth-scrolling')
The metric check_enabled_experiments compares if enabled_experiments_names == ['smooth-scrolling'], which verifies the experiment IS enabled, not disabled
This evaluator will fail when the task is correctly completed (experiment disabled) and pass when the task fails (experiment still enabled)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change expected.rules.names from ['smooth-scrolling'] to [] (empty list) to verify the experiment was removed from enabled list
Or modify the metric to check that 'smooth-scrolling' is NOT in the enabled_experiments_names list
Or change the instruction to say 'enable' instead of 'disable' to match the current expected value (but this would change the task semantics)
